description: Can you get out of a Base token, and what does it cost? Executes a buy and a full sell through its deepest Uniswap v2/v3/v4 WETH or ETH pool in one simulated Base block and returns the ETH that comes back, the round-trip cost and the revert reason if a leg fails. $0.01 per call over x402 (Base USDC first).

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the same base64 payload you would put in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Pass it here and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: base_exit_check
